mail.note: Saturday run. Every mail in the window is Friday 11-Sep dated; no broker mail has arrived since 18:30Z / 00:00 IST. The 21 per-entity structural-watch queries returned zero hits in today's window.

bullets.text: White House copper tariff plan stalling removes a near-term prop under global copper prices, a mild headwind to Hindustan Copper's LME-linked realisations.
bullets.source: Kotak — Basic materials - daily news and prices

bullets.text: US aluminium producers forming a tariff-advocacy alliance signals persisting tariff uncertainty, a watch item for Hindalco's Novelis US remelt footprint.
bullets.source: Kotak — Basic materials - daily news and prices

bullets.text: Coking coal spiked +26% MoM to ~$287/t on Shanxi and Mongolia supply cuts, a level-setting cost hit landing hardest on thinnest-margin mills.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley — PULSE: India Materials: India Steel Tracker

bullets.text: Domestic iron ore's discount to import parity narrowed to ~52%, a cost headwind specific to JSW and Jindal external ore, not Tata/SAIL captive.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley — PULSE: India Materials: India Steel Tracker

bullets.text: HRC's discount to import parity widened to ~2%, leaving mills room to push prices further as demand picks up post-monsoon.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley — PULSE: India Materials: India Steel Tracker

bullets.text: Meghalaya government paused Shree Cement work pending inquiry, a name-specific regulatory risk with no read-through to the other three.
bullets.source: Kotak — Basic materials - daily news and prices

bullets.text: JPM stays OW UltraTech into a seasonally weak Sept quarter, betting the October demand uptick revalidates its premium multiple.
bullets.source: JPM — India Daily: Ultratech: With premium metrics come premium multiples | C-Suite Chat KTAs: LTM, Tata Technologies

bullets.text: Iron ore and pellet imports hit an 11-year high in August despite domestic ore below import parity, signalling tight NMDC availability.
bullets.source: Kotak — Basic materials - daily news and prices

bullets.text: South African coal portside prices in India surging on tight supply lifts the landed-cost floor, room for Coal India e-auction premiums to hold.
bullets.source: Kotak — Basic materials - daily news and prices

bullets.text: Aditya Birla reiterates BUY on Kaynes, TP Rs4,300, on an FY26-29E revenue and EBITDA CAGR guide of 41% and 42%.
bullets.source: Aditya Birla Capital — Mgt. Meet KTAs: KAYNES IN (BUY), Core EMS Momentum Intact; PCB/OSAT Capabilities Take Shape

bullets.text: Kaynes FCF stays negative through FY28E on elevated capex and working capital despite that growth guide, a cash-conversion risk.
bullets.source: Aditya Birla Capital — Mgt. Meet KTAs: KAYNES IN (BUY), Core EMS Momentum Intact; PCB/OSAT Capabilities Take Shape

bullets.text: OSAT is a new Kaynes growth leg at FY29E revenue Rs11.2bn, and PCB capacity is being absorbed by existing customers.
bullets.source: Aditya Birla Capital — Mgt. Meet KTAs: KAYNES IN (BUY), Core EMS Momentum Intact; PCB/OSAT Capabilities Take Shape

bullets.text: LTM says 55-60% of client contracts have already taken AI-deflation pricing cuts, with the rest expected within four to six quarters.
bullets.source: JPM — India Daily: C-Suite Chat KTAs: LTM, Tata Technologies

bullets.text: Tata Technologies says OEMs are accelerating outsourcing to cut costs amid Chinese competition, with non-anchor clients set to outgrow anchor accounts.
bullets.source: JPM — India Daily: C-Suite Chat KTAs: LTM, Tata Technologies

bullets.text: CLSA calls AI-driven manpower deflation a net negative for Indian IT, headcount growth flat despite emerging consulting and adoption opportunities.
bullets.source: CLSA — GCC Expert Webinar | Met Top GPU | Initiation: China Battery | AXSB Call KTAs | NIITMTS

bullets.text: Dated crude jumped to $120.8/bbl from $101.7/bbl over the week on US-Iran escalation and hawkish Fed repricing into the Sept 16 FOMC.
bullets.source: Kotak — Strategy: Friday Flash: Risk off

bullets.text: Nifty fell 2.1% for a fifth straight week; FIIs sold $0.6bn of equities and INR fell 1.1%, the worst-performing EM currency.
bullets.source: CLSA — India strategy: Weekly wrap

bullets.text: India-focused fund outflows moderated to ~$100mn from $170mn, $270mn and $366mn in prior weeks, improving relative to Taiwan and Korea.
bullets.source: Elara — Global Liquidity Tracker: India outflows persist but improve relative to Taiwan & Korea

bullets.text: NSE's Rs225bn IPO, the second-largest ever, opens Sept 17-21, a sizeable liquidity draw on the secondary market to watch.
bullets.source: CLSA — India Financials: NSE announces price band for Rs225 bn IPO | UPI MDR notification soon?

bullets.text: Kotak flags Kumiai's Yen4.5bn FY26 profit cut and AXEEV inventory write-down on generic entry, reiterating SELL on PI Industries.
bullets.source: Kotak — PI Industries (CMP Rs2,246, SELL): Kumiai Chemical writes down Axeev inventories citing pricing pressure

bullets.text: CLSA raises Sterlite Tech target to Rs1,400 from Rs950 on ~70% utilisation and an FY29 Rs200bn revenue target from hyperscaler AI demand.
bullets.source: CLSA — Sterlite Tech (SOTL IN): Plant visit and another raise

ai_semis.text: Semis rallied overnight: SOX +1.81%, AMD +2.49%, TSMC ADR +1.22%, Broadcom +0.32%; Nvidia flat at -0.03% (11-Sep close).
US indices closed broadly higher: S&P 500 +0.86%, Nasdaq +0.96%, Dow +0.98% (11-Sep close).
GIFT Nifty 23,575 implies a +177pt / +0.76% gap to the 23,398 Nifty close, but Indian markets are shut today.
